text:
riley: Massive thanks to @theo and @aisha  for covering badge access this weekend so the contractors could finish the rack move. saved us a day of work. :sparkles:
theo: no problem! jumped in at 8am, escorted the crew, and left a post-it map on the desk with the new rack numbers. happy it went smoothly.
aisha: also left a stack of thank-you donuts in the break room 370 please help yourselves. small treats for a big coordination win.
carlos: Donut report: blueberry and cinnamon wins. morale +30. sending extra kudos to whoever labeled the cables.
meera: real talk: this kind of cross-team hustle is why we get stuff done. adding kudos to the weekly roundup. :trophy:
kudos-bot: Awarded 2 kudos to theo for "Badge wrangling" and 1 kudos to aisha for "Snack diplomacy".
ops-bot: Facilities log updated: Rack move completed (ticket #RM-449). Contractors cleared by 09:12.
riley: i'm dropping a quick note in #operations and backing up the access list change in the audit doc. also tagging security to confirm temporary badge rules.
aisha: also, picture proof of donut generosity: <donut_stack.jpg>  free for all.
theo: tiny PSA: if you need weekend access next time, ping me and i'll add a temp badge in the morning window.
carlos: proposing a small sticker: "weekend warrior" for folks who help off-hours. meera, can design?
meera: love it. will mock up two versions (badge and tiny laptop sticker) and post in #design.
riley: adding two kudos entries: "theo - morning badge run" and "aisha - snack diplomacy". will include photos and the rack map link.
kudos-bot: Kudos confirmed and added to the team leaderboard.
ops-bot: Reminder: please file any post-event notes in the RM-449 ticket if there were access hiccups.
theo: night crew solidarity. thank you everyone for the quick coordination.
aisha: donuts for all, stickers to follow. that's a wrap. :raised_hands:
